note: Eval tuning for the real skills corpus (eval/corpus.json). Real SKILL.md files carry their routing signal in description+name only (no actions/domains/examples frontmatter), so description/name weights are raised and actions/domains lowered. Threshold lowered to 0.38 so description-rich prompts route while chit-chat still passes through (FPR stays 0). body (0.05) scores trigger words in SKILL.md bodies; a body-only match stays below the threshold, so it only nudges near-miss routing (keeps the skill:skill-creator vs agent:skill-creator race correct). These values are the shipped defaults (src/config.ts).
